WireError.description:
The body every non-2xx answer of the service's own routes carries: a stable kebab-case code a caller decides
on, and one English sentence for a person.

info.description: The web console's server: the account service on sumida, which holds the users, the senders linked to them, the grants they hold, the account model they stand in, the room holdings the receiver asks about, the fixed lines a room says, and the secret store, which writes the files every unit reads its secrets from and answers no value. Its own routes answer in the common wire format: camelCase keys, times as integers of epoch milliseconds, ids as signed 64-bit integers, and every failure as a non-2xx answer carrying code and error. sumida's session routes are mounted under /sumida and take the session cookie instead of the bearer token; their refusals are sumida's own shape. A user's id is answered as the digits of sumida's whole number, a string a caller hands on as it stands.
